Welcome to Mix The Color! 🎨

Memorize the color, then mix it from Red, Yellow, Blue, White and Black paint! Go 1v1: the closest match wins the round. Lose a round, lose a heart. Last one standing wins!

👀 Memorize the color
🧪 Mix it drop by drop
🏆 Closest match wins!

👍LIKE + JOIN GROUP👍

Our Game Supports
💻 PC | 🎮 Console | 📱 Mobile

Invite your friends to get even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮
